In the simplified textbook model, annual turnover exceeds the exemption threshold. The fourth-quarter KU1 base already determined under textbook rules is €140,000 and the rate is 3 per mille. Calculate KU1 and give the year-end entry, later payment and profit effect of each.
questions.correctAnswer: €140,000 × 0.003 = €420. Year end: 7780 420 / 3540 420, profit −€420. Payment: 3540 420 / 2800 420, profit €0. The model does not replace checking current legal exclusions and graduated rates.
